summary: As versões original e revisada cumpriram os critérios em 6/6 casos cada; sem skill, 5/6. As 18 decisões principais foram corretas. A diferença foi a ausência de um controle negativo na condição sem skill. Não foi demonstrado ganho incremental da revisão sobre a versão anterior.

limits: Six known development cases from three skills; not representative of 138 skills, not holdouts.
One fresh actor per case/condition, same inherited model and effort, no model override; no variance or cost estimate.
Coordinator grading is unblinded, with criteria fixed beforehand; no rubric changed in response to outputs.
No automatically enforced read isolation or complete independent access trace; actor declarations are not proof of zero exposure.
The full manifest protects frozen criteria; the redundant auxiliary criteria digest had an IDs-only serialization error, disclosed in freeze audit.
Independent coordinator controls validate artifacts but cannot substitute for a required actor action.
Technical runs target Java 21/16 on Temurin 25.0.3 with declared cached JUnit/Guava, not executions on Java 21/16 runtimes.
